name: founder-id
description: The founder-id skill pack for Claude: build and run a business in Indonesia

plugins.name: founder-id
plugins.description: Nineteen Claude skills for founders in Indonesia: board, competitors, a consumer panel of 100 Indonesian buyer agents, pricing, the offer, a CFO in Rupiah, marketing, brand, operations, launch, the business plan, the Indonesia desk, a no-POS logbook, and six run skills (weekly report, P&L, cash flow, cost leak, product mix, staffing).
